semantics: Permission-set absence is structural across fully enumerated organization accounts. Credential-report no-use markers are bounded by AWS tracking start, current credential date and generated report time; missing or unsupported values are unresolved.
limits: No Identity Center permission-use history, service-specific credential use, SSH/signing use, or SAML/OIDC successful federation use is inferred.
legacy_successor_reason: The former console-null branch alarmed on newly created passwords. All report-based inactivity successors now require fresh report time and a sufficient current-credential interval, with console-only and key-only populations kept separate.
